presentation_contract.structured_results: Lead with the answer or important correction, then use compact review tables with adjacent evidence and material limits.
presentation_contract.relationships: Use a labeled diagram when relationships are the question; label proposals/inferences and provide a text or table fallback when needed.
presentation_contract.plans: Each step states what to do, why, and an observable completion condition; owner/dependency when not obvious.
presentation_contract.coverage: Preserve all scoped items, applicable versions/dates/units, unknowns, and owning machine-readable schemas. Long reports may group tables or link complete continuations.
presentation_contract.language: Use ASD-STE100 for new text. Use short sentences, clear actions, and consistent technical terms. Preserve exact code, labels, and quotations.
